- Discover a celestial bloom with our elegant flower pendant necklace. Featuring a radiant starburst design at its center, framed by a delicate halo of sparkling crystals, this piece is a perfect blend of modern and classic. Crafted from durable anti-tarnish stainless steel and plated in 18K gold, it's a perfect accessory for everyday elegance or a special occasion.
-
- Premium Quality | Anti-Tarnish
- Base Material: Stainless Steel
- Plating: 18K Gold-Plated
- Shape: Starburst Flower
- Size: One-size & Adjustable
- Net Quantity: 1
- Designed to complement both casual and formal outfits effortlessly
- Care Tips:
-
- Wipe with a soft cloth after every use
- Avoid contact with harsh chemicals, sprays, and perfumes
- Store in a flat box to prevent scratches
- Do not soak in water
